title: 1997 Pocket Monsters Carddass #000 Bandai Starters, PSA 10
description: Bandai Carddass checklist and starters slab from the Pocket Monsters set. Printed in 1997 for the early Bandai Carddass series, this PSA 10 example covers the starter trio and checklist art collectors look for when building a first-wave Japanese set. Surfaces stay sharp under the slab; corners and edges grade clean. A strong reference piece for Carddass-era Pokémon in top grade.
